text: that flow is already confusing as hell lol. so you want me to go to the top right, ok i added this water i think [Image #2] lol
resolution: Added a WATER tab to the iso build pane's palette (the PIECES rail the user actually builds in), so a body of water drops by clicking the ground — same gesture as a floor/prop — instead of the confusing OBJ-tab → 2D-canvas → iso-pane round trip. The tab arms a water preset; a ground click fires onPlaceWaterBody(kind,x,z), which the cart lowers to an ordinary water placement (cat 'water') at that world position via worldToPlacementGraph + place.onPaintAt. This reuses the entire existing pipeline (persistence, assemblePreviewWorld → world.waterBodies, translucent render, footing, compiled bake) — no new authoring system. Guarded the iso pane's piece-catalog lookups (ghost, status text, paintKindOf) against water preset ids so nothing crashes. The OBJ-tab WATER catalog still works as a secondary path.
